newsitem.title: USA: Otter Tail Power files shelf registrations.
newsitem.headline: Otter Tail Power files shelf registrations.

text.p: Otter Tail Power Co said Friday it filed a shelf registration to issue up to $50 million of debt securities, which may be sold from time to time in one or more series.
It also filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to issue up to one million common shares for its Automatic Dividend Reinvestment and Share Purchase Plan.
Otter Tail said terms of the debt securities will be determined at the time of sale.

It said proceeds from the issue and sale of any debt securities will be used to repay short-term and other indebtedness, to redeem one or more of the outstanding series of the company's first mortgage bonds and for general corporate purposes.
